core_obligations: Set up the framework lemma: its assumptions (1) and (2) follow from the cited locality lemmas for closed immersions and quasi-compact morphisms (proof lines 1945-1951).

Consider the cartesian diagram of algebraic spaces over $S$ with $Z' \to Z$ surjective flat of affine schemes and $X' \to Z'$ a quasi-compact immersion; the morphism $X' \to Z'$ is quasi-affine (proof lines 1952-1961).

Conclude by descent of quasi-affineness that $X$ is a scheme and $X \to Z$ is quasi-affine, then that $X \to Z$ is a quasi-compact immersion by the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma (proof lines 1961-1968).
proof_roadmap: Feed the locality assumptions into the framework lemma.
Extract quasi-affineness of the quasi-compact immersion on the chart.
Descend quasi-affineness to make $X$ a scheme, then apply the scheme-side descent lemma.
difficulty_reason: The proof is the quasi-compact-immersion instance of the intermediate-step descent pattern: the framework lemma's assumptions follow from the cited locality lemmas for closed immersions and quasi-compact morphisms; a quasi-compact immersion is in particular quasi-affine, so the delivered descent of quasi-affineness makes $X$ a scheme with $X \to Z$ quasi-affine, and the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma concludes.
